text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"I lost last time... but I'm definitely 
going to win this time!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Of course. There's no way I'm letting them 
look down on me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Run a race they can't take their eyes off 
of, and cross the finish line in 1st 
place—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'll prove to them... that I can do it...!
